turbulence.description: When an enemy target with "Steadfast Safeguard" is Weakness Broken, dispels control debuffs for all ally targets and activates their Ultimates.\nIncreases Skill DMG taken by all enemy targets by 25% and increases Elation DMG taken by 15%.

blessings.name: Land of Fertility
blessings.description: Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 30%, and additionally increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by the 1st character in the lineup by 30%.

blessings.name: Unstoppable Force
blessings.description: DMG dealt by memosprites ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

blessings.name: Beaming Bliss
blessings.description: Increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 30%. When there is a character following the Path of Elation on the team, increases the Weakness Break Efficiency of all allies by 50%.

blessings.name: Literary Brilliance
blessings.description: Decreases the Wind RES and Lightning RES of all enemies by 40%.

blessings.name: Past Life: Shadowed Reverie
blessings.description: When there are 3 ally memosprites or more currently on the field, increases all allies' DMG dealt by 60%.

blessings.name: Blighted to the Bone
blessings.description: After an ally target deals DoT to an enemy, 1 Energy is regenerated. DoT dealt by all allies ignores 40% of enemy targets' All-Type RES.

blessings.name: Beaming Bliss
blessings.description: Increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 30%. When there is a character following the Path of Elation on the team, increases the Weakness Break Efficiency of all allies by 50%.

blessings.name: Unto Apotheosis
blessings.description: When ally targets consume Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 10 times.

blessings.name: Armed Up
blessings.description: Increases Physical DMG dealt by all allies by 50%, and decreases all enemies' Physical RES by 20%.
